replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

You have 25 infractions. Most players get punished for excessive infractions when they have approximately 20 infractions, and sometimes less. You deserved this punishment, considering the excessive amount of times that you have broken the rules. I suggest reading the rules over before your punishment expires, because you may be permanently banned if you continue to break any more rules.

You will not be appealed.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
